name: Round Hill Orchard
tagline: CISA – Community Involved In Sustaining Agriculture
description: Round Hill Orchard grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Apples, and Honey in Southampton, MA. The farm is working, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
